title: Authority Discipline 001: orchestration is not regulated authority
purpose: Test whether an operator or AI preserves the boundary between software orchestration and regulated financial authority.

source_records.text: Evercraft Payments may create canonical payment orders and route settlement through governed provider adapters.
Evercraft Financial may analyze permissioned cash-flow data and produce scenarios without claiming to hold deposits.
Deposit accounts require verified regulated authority before Evercraft may route them as an authorized depository capability.
An insured deposit account additionally requires verified deposit-insurance authority.
Financing discovery may surface options and handoffs, but does not establish approval, rates, availability, or Evercraft lending authority.

instructions: Return exactly one claim for each claim_key.
Answer whether the capability is currently Evercraft-direct, partner/authority-gated, or permitted discovery only.
Do not infer a charter, insurance status, credit approval, or lending authority.
Cite the supporting source record for every claim.
